package.description: Windows tray app that monitors all your Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions at once — live status, click-to-focus, and official 5h/7d usage bars.

en-US.description: Windows tray app that monitors all your Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions at once — live status, click-to-focus, and official 5h/7d usage bars.
en-US.longDescription: A lightweight Windows tray app that shows every running Claude Code and Codex session (in WSL and native Windows) with live status, lets you click a session to focus its terminal, and shows official 5h/7d usage bars captured from each CLI's own data — no tokens read, no undocumented endpoints called.
en-US.name: MyAgents
